theorem: The complete halfwidth-0.00075 nuisance cube is tiled first by 40^3 outward cells. Every failed base cell is replaced by all eight children, recursively. The recorded leaf family is a complete partition because passing parents are retained and every failing parent is exhaustively replaced. When the final failed count is zero, this produces a full adaptive Krawczyk cover and proves that the ST269 failure was a resolution failure rather than a root boundary at 0.00075.
